items.raw_excerpt: The Bull Inn in West Tanfield is a great pub with three different outdoor spots to enjoy a pint and meal while visiting the village.
items.summary_en: The Bull Inn in West Tanfield is a charming pub in a pretty Yorkshire village. It has three outdoor areas where visitors can enjoy drinks and meals by the river. The village pub is well worth a visit for its lovely riverside setting.
items.summary_ko: 웨스트 탄필드에 있는 불 인은 예쁜 요크셔 마을의 매력적인 펍입니다. 강가에서 음료와 식사를 즐길 수 있는 야외 공간이 세 곳이나 있습니다. 이 마을 펍은 아름다운 강변 풍경으로 방문할 가치가 충분합니다.

items.summary_en: Brazilian municipalities can apply for the Elderly-Friendly City title by meeting specific requirements. The award recognizes local public policies that support senior citizens. Cities across the country compete for this recognition.
